introduction.definition: A spiral heat exchanger is two long plates wound into a spiral, forming two separate channels. One fluid spirals inward, the other outward — counter-current in single channels. The curved channel and high shear make it self-cleaning, ideal for fouling liquids and slurries.
applications: Heat recovery in pulp & paper and wastewater
key_points: Single channel per side — no bypassing
Covers open for full channel access
introduction.summary: A spiral heat exchanger is made of two long metal plates rolled into a spiral, forming two separate channels. One fluid spirals in toward the centre, the other spirals out — true counter-current flow in a single channel each. The curved single channel scrubs itself, so it handles fouling fluids and slurries well.

alignment: Provide pull-out space for tube bundles or plates; align nozzles to piping without strain.
piping: Install vents and drains on both sides; fit strainers where fouling solids are expected.

video_tutorials.title: Spiral Heat Exchanger — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Spiral Heat Exchanger.
A spiral heat exchanger is two long plates wound into a spiral, forming two separate channels.
One fluid spirals inward, the other outward — counter-current in single channels.
The curved channel and high shear make it self-cleaning, ideal for fouling liquids and slurries.
Typical applications include slurries, sludges and fibrous liquids; heat recovery in pulp & paper and wastewater; condensing vapours; viscous and fouling process fluids.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Outer Shell with Tangential Nozzles, Front Cover with Centre Nozzle (hidden in cutaway), Rear Cover with Centre Nozzle.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Spiral Heat Exchanger — Operation

script.narration: How the Spiral Heat Exchanger works.
Hot fluid enters at the periphery and spirals toward the centre.
Cold fluid enters at the centre cover and spirals outward.
Heat passes through the spiral plates between the channels.
Covers seal alternate sides of the channels and open for cleaning.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Spiral Heat Exchanger.
Monitor ΔP and temperatures.
Open covers and flush/clean channels.
Replace cover gaskets.
Watch for channel blockage: high ΔP. Common cause: solids above design size.
Watch for gasket leak: external leak. Common cause: ageing.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
